definitionEn: Absence of cascading failures from one element to another, such as from QM to ASIL software.

example.en: How do you ensure freedom from interference between QM and ASIL D software?
example.ko: QM 소프트웨어와 ASIL D 소프트웨어 사이의 간섭 자유를 어떻게 보장합니까?

definitionEn: Rules for writing source code, such as MISRA C.

example.en: How are deviations from MISRA C justified and approved?
example.ko: MISRA C 위반 사항은 어떻게 근거를 남기고 승인합니까?

definitionEn: Analyzing source code without executing it, using a tool.

example.en: Are all static analysis warnings reviewed before release?
example.ko: 릴리스 전에 정적 분석 경고를 모두 검토합니까?

meaningKo: 소프트웨어 유닛 (더 이상 나누지 않고 시험하는 최소 단위)
definitionEn: The smallest software element that is tested independently.

example.en: How is a software unit defined in your project?
example.ko: 귀사 프로젝트에서 소프트웨어 유닛은 어떻게 정의됩니까?

definitionEn: Deriving test cases from the requirements to show that each requirement is met.

example.en: Are all unit test cases derived from the requirements?
example.ko: 모든 유닛 시험 케이스가 요구사항에서 도출되었습니까?

definitionEn: How much of the code structure was executed by the tests.

example.en: How do you justify the code that is not covered by tests?
example.ko: 시험으로 커버되지 않은 코드는 어떻게 근거를 제시합니까?

meaningKo: 수정 조건/결정 커버리지 (ASIL D 유닛 시험에서 강력 권고)
definitionEn: Coverage showing that each condition independently affects the decision outcome.

example.en: What MC/DC coverage did you achieve for the ASIL D units?
example.ko: ASIL D 유닛에서 MC/DC 커버리지를 얼마나 달성했습니까?

meaningKo: 백투백 시험 (모델과 생성 코드의 결과 비교)
definitionEn: Comparing the outputs of a model and the generated code with the same inputs.

example.en: Do you perform back-to-back tests between the Simulink model and the code?
example.ko: Simulink 모델과 코드 사이에 백투백 시험을 수행합니까?

definitionEn: Testing a real ECU connected to a simulated environment.

example.en: Which safety requirements are verified on the HIL test bench?
example.ko: 어떤 안전 요구사항이 HIL 시험 벤치에서 검증됩니까?
